body:

(See Terror Planet). subject: Lag, And our trans Atlantic cousins
author: kevlar0
body:
So far I haven't experienced any lag, except when people join the room, then its only a millisecond or so, Played in quite a few 8 player rooms,  This is absolutely manic when everybody is on the beach competing for the same ramp space, Cheap takedowns galore, Can i just add on the takedown front, when you are going in the same direction at pace, Burnout 3 takedown phyics seem to come into play and its not so easy (top tip,, hit the back wheel arch), good battles ahead i forsee.

If you are in a room with friends you could try the Newton drive to hot tin roof race, I haven't done it in an 8 player yet, but i'm sure if there were any lag issues this would show it up. . Joining other rooms is quick and easy, Providing the servers ain't playing up,

Our American brothers are loud as usual. and there quest in life seems to be to take you down at every availble opportunity, them scream "yeah bitch, how do you like them apples?"  Then hearing them gasp,  "How the flock did you get such a massive flatspin, i'm gonna beat it"   but they don't get anywhere near, lmao x2. 

SNUFFLER, Mrs raaaa and myself would appear to be the kings and queen of flatspin and airtime at the mo, but i can see that changing very soon.

Played the demo to death, loving it, SLUFFER and I have prolly racked up over a million hours on it already, and analysed every jump, shortcut and stuntrun to death,

25th of Jan can't come soon enough.

my dog ate my disc.
